volume.description: SID master volume 0-15. Writes all of $D418, clearing filter mode bits.

filterMode.description: Optional $D418 bits 4-7 (0-15: low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, voice 3 off). Default 0 clears them.

hard.description: If true, perform a hard register scrub; otherwise silence voices softly.

voice.description: SID voice to trigger (1-3). Limits depend on op.

note.description: Musical note like A4, C#5, or Bb3. Overrides frequencyHz if provided.

frequencyHz.description: Explicit frequency in Hz. Used when note is omitted.

system.description: PAL or NTSC for the note frequency. Default: read from the machine ($02A6).

waveform.description: SID waveform to enable. Limits depend on op.

pulseWidth.description: Pulse width (0-4095). Used for pulse waveform.

verify.description: Record audio after silencing to confirm the output is quiet.

path.description: SID, PRG or audio file path (absolute or Ultimate).

songnr.description: Song number within the SID file (0-based index).

pattern.description: Repeating lead semitone offsets from root.

preset.description: Classic or varied lead phrasing. Limits depend on op.

sidwave.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object. Limits depend on op.

cpg.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object. Limits depend on op.

format.description: Source format hint when providing raw text.

output.description: Target format. PRG works everywhere; SID playback needs C64U/U64 or U2 (SID export with dryRun works everywhere).

dryRun.description: Skip playback; return only compilation metadata.

outputPath.description: Host file for the compiled PRG or SID (allowed directories only). Works with dryRun.

analysisDurationSeconds.description: Verification seconds. Limits depend on op.

waitBeforeCaptureMs.description: Verification delay in ms. Limits depend on op.

expectedSidwave.description: Reference SIDWAVE. Limits depend on op.

silenceWaitMs.description: Delay before silence capture in ms.

request.description: Verification goal wording; "does it sound right" requests add a verdict.

durationSeconds.description: Override capture duration in seconds. Limits depend on op.

description:
Sound operations.

Operations:
- sample_render [write]: Render a SIDWAVE sample to WAV. Optional inputs: definition, rate, outputDir.
- capture_samples [c64u]: Capture Ultimate stereo PCM. Optional inputs: count, encoding.
- set_volume [write]: Set SID volume ($D418). Required inputs: volume. Optional inputs: filterMode.
- reset [write]: Reset SID registers. Optional inputs: hard.
- note_on [write]: Start a SID voice. Optional inputs: voice, note, frequencyHz, system, waveform, pulseWidth, attack, decay, sustain, release.
- note_off [write]: Release a SID voice. Required inputs: voice.
- silence_all [write]: Silence all SID voices. Optional inputs: verify.
- play_sid_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play an Ultimate SID file. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: songnr.
- play_mod_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play an Ultimate MOD file. Required inputs: path.
- generate [write]: Compose and play a seeded SIDWAVE PRG (replaces the program in memory). Optional inputs: includeScore, configure, root, pattern, steps, tempoMs, waveform, preset, system, style, seed.
- compile_play [write]: Compile and optionally play SIDWAVE. Optional inputs: configure, sidwave, cpg, format, output, dryRun, outputPath.
- play_preset [write]: Compile and play a built-in SID preset. Optional inputs: includeScore, configure, preset, platforms, verify, analysisDurationSeconds, waitBeforeCaptureMs, restoreActiveBackend.
- pipeline [write]: Compile, play and analyze SIDWAVE. Optional inputs: configure, sidwave, cpg, output, waitBeforeCaptureMs, analysisDurationSeconds, expectedSidwave, verifySilenceBefore, verifySilenceAfter, silenceDurationSeconds, silenceRmsThreshold, postSilenceWaitMs, silenceWaitMs.
- analyze: Analyze SID playback or a host WAV. Optional inputs: wavPath, request, durationSeconds, expectedSidwave.
- record_analyze: Analyze a recording from the Ultimate stream or host microphone on other backends. Required inputs: durationSeconds. Optional inputs: expectedSidwave.
